notes.title: Dev Update | What's Changed in a Month? A Lot.
notes.notes: [p]Hey Pioneers — it's been a while! We're back with a big update on [i]XenoHaven[/i], our alien-world sandbox survival game.[/p][p]Since our first playtest, we've been carefully listening to your feedback and reworking key parts of the game's systems and direction. And now, we're thrilled to announce that...[/p][p]🎉 [b]Playtest #2 begins on July 24th![/b][/p][p]📍 Steam Page:[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3461270/_/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]📌 [b]How to join the playtest?[/b][/p][p]On July 24, head to our Steam page and request access to the playtest. Once approved, you'll be able to download and jump straight into the updated build.[/p][p]🛠️ If you participated in the first playtest, you don't need to reapply — just update or reinstall [i]XenoHaven Playtest[/i] from your library on the 24th to access the latest version.[/p][p] [/p][p]Want to see what's new?[/p][p]🎬 Check out the visual updates and progress in our latest [url=https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV12XuszxERu/] dev video [/url].[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45559598/fde44f8c1d973e7cf65287f6011eee7768c0631c.png"][/img][/p][p]Thanks again for your continued support — we can't wait to hear what you think of the new changes![/p][p][/p][h3][b]Follow our community to get the latest information![/b][/h3][p]💬[b]Discord:[/b] [url="https://discord.gg/p8jHhK7QH2"]https://discord.gg/p8jHhK7QH2[/url][/p][p]🔗[b]X: [/b][url="https://x.com/XenoHaven01"]https://x.com/XenoHaven01[/url][/p][p]🔗[b]Bluesky: [/b][url="https://bsky.app/profile/xenohaven.bsky.social"]https://bsky.app/profile/xenohaven.bsky.social[/url][/p][p][/p]
